notes.title: 2024/04/01 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*]<Additional information> added to the character items in the Album. This can be viewed when the favorability increases.
[*]Fixed some of the images.
[*]Fixed some text.
[/list]

notes.title: 2023/01/16 Update(Minor bug fixes)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a case where it would not start on macOS.
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented play in certain language regions.
[/list]

notes.title: 2023/01/14 Update(Minor bug fixes)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented play in certain language regions.
[/list]

notes.title: 2021/11/23 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] With this version, we are ending the early release and releasing it as the official version.
[*] Character parts images have been added to the character creation scene.
[*] Character background images have been added to the character creation scene.
[/list]

notes.title: 2021/11/08 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem where the slider for changing color was not displayed when selecting other parts after selecting the background image in the character creation scene.
[/list]

notes.title: 2021/11/05 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Character scaling has been removed from the character creation scene.
[*] The main character's background image can now be changed in the character creation scene.
[*] Fixed a bug in the character creation scene where changes made to the character's appearance were discarded when returning to the appearance settings after entering a name.
[*] Some text has been corrected.
[/list]

notes.title: 2021/08/05 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] When a resident asks for an item and you don't have it, it will now be displayed in grey.
[*] Some text corrections have been made.
[/list]

notes.title: 2021/03/12 Update (Minor bug fixes)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the color of the list was not correct when the sort order was changed.
[*] Fixed an issue where the focus representing the currently selected item would become abnormal when the sort order was changed.
[*] When transitioning to the gift giving screen, the top item was selected, but now it is changed to nothing selected.
[/list]

notes.title: Update on March 11, 2021
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a new story.
[*] Added equipment sorting.
[*] When purchasing items in the store, the price will now be grayed out if the amount is insufficient to purchase the item.
[*] Fixed some parts of the UI.
[*] Made it easier to understand which item is currently selected in the list.
[*] Item gift quantity can now be changed continuously by holding down the button.
[/list]

notes.title: Update on Feb. 26, 2021
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New levels have been added.
[*] The rank limit has been opened.
[*] Expanded the maximum number of recruitment.
[*] Added a new tone of voice for the main character.
[*] Added materials that can be used for character creation.
[*] The weather has been added. Added weather-related conversations.
[*] Added new residents that can be recruited.
[*] Some UI adjustments have been made.
[/list]

notes.title: Updated on Feb. 15, 2021
notes.content:
Fixed a bug in which the achievements "Training Completed" and "First Class Training Completed" could not be unlocked.
Fixed a bug that prevented the character list from displaying properly in some cases.

notes.title: Update on Feb 09, 2021
notes.content:
We have added a setting to change the screen size and added full screen support. This can be changed from the settings screen.
Added operation explanation to Help.

Added on February 10, 2021: Fixed the problem that the title date of this patch note was wrong.

notes.title: Update on Feb. 1, 2021
notes.content: Added the screen size setting to the configuration.
